title: prdr-yagni contract data
description: Reference schema (FAFF-256). The SHAPE of the PRDR UPPER (YAGNI / value) gate verdict that `faff prdr yagni` PRODUCES and `faff contract prdr-yagni` VALIDATES (consumer-side conformance, mirroring prd-readiness / prdr-admission). It is 255's `upper: {admit, reason}` verdict, plus the two-phase audit trail (the deterministic trace-to-goal precondition, the methodology proposal, the adversarial challenge). NO safe coerce target — faff's own producer emits it, so an out-of-enum proposal.verdict is a fail-loud, never coerced toward `admit`; the gate is fail-safe toward REFUSAL. The load-bearing invariant (an `admit` implies trace_to_goal ∧ proposal.verdict==admit ∧ challenge.ran ∧ ¬challenge.overturns — 'no gold-plating on doubt') is enforced in code as a conformance violation; it is not expressible in this shape schema. Grounding is advisory: `grounding_present` is shape-checked but never gate-decisive.
